testcases.name: flux-2-dev-fp8-l0
testcases.description: FLUX.2-dev FP8 L0 representative at 384px with full text shape and reduced denoising steps
testcases.test_prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
testcases.notes: PR L0 repro for FLUX.2-dev FP8. Uses the same checkpoint, FP8 scales, flux.2 model type, Mistral 3 text encoder, Flux2 DiT, 32-channel VAE, runner, comparator, and image artifact contract. L0 keeps the full end-to-end stage, restores the full 256-token text shape for prompt fidelity, uses a 384px image to reduce DiT/VAE scale, and uses twenty denoising steps; nightly keeps the full 1024px/28-step scale coverage.
